display.purpose: Page titles and key metrics (28px; 36px for hero figures).

title.purpose: Panel and card titles (20px; 18px for sub-headers).

body.purpose: Default content, table rows, dense lists (14px; 13px).

label.purpose: Table headers, statistic labels, badges — uppercase with tracking.

amount.purpose: All monetary values — JetBrains Mono, tabular-nums, tight tracking.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus ring on inputs and controls.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: State transitions on buttons, inputs, nav items.

motion.name: smooth
motion.purpose: Decorative motion such as entry fades.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Two-column surfaces stack to a single column.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single loud action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--transactions-font-body); font-weight: 500; height: 36px; min-width: 72px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--transactions-color-primary); color: var(--transactions-color-text-inverse); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--transactions-color-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--transactions-color-primary-active); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--transactions-color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default secondary action with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: var(--transactions-font-body); font-weight: 500; height: 36px; min-width: 72px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--transactions-color-window-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--transactions-color-major-background); color: var(--transactions-color-text-major); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--transactions-color-border-l2); background: var(--transactions-color-hover-bg); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--transactions-color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Danger Button
components.description: Inline destructive action; quiet until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-text-danger { font-family: var(--transactions-font-body); font-weight: 500; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--transactions-color-expense); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-text-danger:hover { background: var(--transactions-color-danger-hover-bg); } .ds-btn-text-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--transactions-color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Standard text field with hairline border and focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--transactions-color-window-border); border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--transactions-font-body); font-size: 14px; color: var(--transactions-color-text-major); background: var(--transactions-color-major-background); transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--transactions-color-text-disabled); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--transactions-color-border-l2); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--transactions-color-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(57, 100, 254, 0.25); outline: none; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat Paper surface with a hairline border and an amount in mono.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--transactions-color-major-background); border: 1px solid var(--transactions-color-window-border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: var(--transactions-shadow-sm); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: var(--transactions-font-display); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--transactions-color-text-major); } .ds-card-amount { margin: 0; font-family: var(--transactions-font-mono); font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--transactions-color-text-major); }

components.name: Income Tag
components.description: Semantic chip: 10% tint fill, semantic text, no border.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--transactions-color-income-tint); color: var(--transactions-color-income); font-family: var(--transactions-font-body); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Left-rail nav item with quiet default and tinted active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--transactions-color-text-secondary); font-family: var(--transactions-font-body); font-size: 13px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--transactions-color-hover-bg); color: var(--transactions-color-text-major); } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--transactions-color-active-bg); color: var(--transactions-color-primary); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--transactions-color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Transactions is a desktop workstation for personal finance. The interface stays clean and airy — cool neutral surfaces, generous white space, and a single blue accent — so the numbers are the loudest thing on screen. Trustworthiness comes from precision: every amount is set in monospace with tabular figures, every layer is separated by a hairline or a tone rather than a heavy shadow, and every interactive element announces itself with a clear focus ring. The system is refined and restrained by design: components are small, consistent, and quiet, built for dense data work rather than spectacle. Nothing competes with the ledger. Depth is expressed through light layering — surface tone plus 1px borders — with shadows reserved for genuine lift: hovers, popovers, and modals.
keyCharacteristics: One accent voice (Clarity Blue) across actions, focus, and selection.
Cool neutral hierarchy (Canvas / Paper / Soft Gray) with hairline dividers.
Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums for every monetary value.
8px-based spacing rhythm; compact 36px controls at the heart of the system.
Light layering: tone and hairlines first, shadows only where surfaces truly lift.
Dual theme (light + dark) over the same token names; dark values are tuned for contrast, never re-themed.

rules.name: The Semantic Silo Rule
rules.body: Income/expense/transfer/outlier colors appear only on transaction or stock data — never on chrome, navigation, or brand surfaces.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Clarity Blue is the system's only accent color. There is no secondary accent; emphasis comes from weight and placement.

rules.name: The Mono Money Rule
rules.body: Every monetary amount renders in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums and slightly negative letter-spacing. Never typeset money in the body face.

rules.name: The Hairline Layering Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with tone and a 1px hairline first; add shadows only when a surface actually needs to lift (hover, popover, modal).

dos: Do use the `--transactions-*` tokens for every color, size, and spacing value; never introduce one-off hex values.
Do set every monetary amount in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums and tight tracking.
Do confine income/expense/transfer/outlier colors to transaction and stock data.
Do layer surfaces with tone and 1px hairlines before reaching for shadows.
Do add a 2px Clarity Blue focus ring to every interactive element.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion` and use the project's custom scrollbar mixin.
donts: Don't use browser-default scrollbars or OS-native window chrome (the frameless window keeps its custom title bar).
Don't paint chrome or navigation with income/expense/transfer/outlier colors.
Don't add a second accent color.
Don't use shadows to create hierarchy where a hairline and a tone will do.
